layman_headline: Market is cooling off after a massive rally week — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a huge week with BTC up 23%, ETH up 29%, and many altcoins up 30-55%. Now prices are pulling back 2-8% in the last 24 hours as traders take profits. Our existing XRP position is down 7.7% from entry but still above our stop-loss at $1.30. Every swing candidate on the watchlist is either overbought, a stablecoin, or has already run too far too fast to chase safely.
layman_action: Hold the current XRP position and wait. Don't chase coins that have already surged 30-55% in a week. If XRP drops to $1.30, we cut the loss. If the broader market stabilizes and pulls back further, better entry opportunities will appear in the next few days.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present unfavorable risk/reward at current levels. PUMP has RSI at 86 (severely overbought) after a 55% weekly move. XRP, LIT, MON, and ZEC are all extended 28-55% on the week and pulling back sharply (-5 to -12% in 24h), suggesting profit-taking is underway. BTC dominance at 59.3% signals capital is concentrating in Bitcoin rather than flowing to alts, which is a headwind. The Fear & Greed index dropped from 74 to 65, confirming the cooling. Our XRP position at -7.7% is concerning but the stop-loss at $1.30 provides a clear risk floor, and the 44% weekly move shows underlying momentum that could resume after consolidation.
risk_factors: XRP could break below $1.30 stop-loss if broader market profit-taking accelerates
BTC dominance at 59.3% and rising could continue siphoning capital from altcoins
Fear & Greed dropping from 74 to 65 may signal the start of a deeper correction after the massive weekly rally
watch_list: XRP price action around $1.40 support — a break below signals weakness toward $1.30 stop
BTC ability to hold $77,000-78,000 as the first major support after a 23% weekly rally
Fear & Greed index trend — further decline below 60 would suggest risk-off sentiment
market_context: Crypto just had an explosive week (BTC +23%, many alts +30-55%) and is now seeing healthy profit-taking across the board. BTC dominance at 59.3% suggests Bitcoin is leading while alts remain fragile — not ideal for new altcoin entries.
context_banner: Post-rally consolidation phase: the market needs to digest massive weekly gains before the next leg becomes clear.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed dropped from 74 to 65, signaling cooling momentum after an aggressive rally week — caution warranted for new entries.
PUMP RSI at 86 is severely overbought; the only candidate with RSI data confirms the broader theme that this week's movers are extended.
Bitcoin entering 'initial phase' of new bull market per CryptoQuant is constructive medium-term, but $83K cited as key resistance that hasn't been reached.
Massive volumes across the board (BTC $36B, ETH $13B, SOL $4.4B) confirm the rally was real, but 24h pullbacks suggest near-term exhaustion.
Institutional crypto infrastructure developments (OCC charter, POSCO tokenization, LayerZero trading infra) support medium-term bullish thesis but aren't immediate catalysts for altcoin entries.
